The fix is commit `1c19126f11ca5bb93891bd18d89910d20f41ee84` ("(fix) O3-6097: Fix inverted labels on the free text dosage toggle (#3793)", by Sathieskumar Sudeshkar, 2026-10-12). It swapped the `labelA` and `labelB` props on the `ControlledFieldInput` toggle, so `labelA` is now `Off` and `labelB` is now `On`. The toggle's `labelA` is shown when the switch is off and `labelB` when it is on, so the labels now read correctly.

The fix is in `drug-order-form.component.tsx` (lines 981–982 after the change). The same commit adds a regression test in `drug-order-form.test.tsx` (lines 324–337) that checks the label text and checked state before and after toggling. The toggle itself is rendered at lines 508–517 of the component, and its styling is in `drug-order-form.scss`, which the commit did not change.

Note: the repository is `openmrs-esm-patient-chart` in Falkon, not the bare name I first tried. I read only the commit's diff and the surrounding component code. I did not run the test suite.

Evidence, best first:
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/add-drug-order/drug-order-form.component.tsx` lines 981–982: the swapped labels (the fix)
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/add-drug-order/drug-order-form.component.tsx` lines 508–517: the free-text dosage toggle that uses the fixed control
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/add-drug-order/drug-order-form.test.tsx` lines 324–337: regression test for the toggle labels
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/add-drug-order/drug-order-form.scss` line 124: `.freeTextDosageToggle` styling (unchanged by the fix)
